hook: Every run from every watch, in one iPhone app

beats.say: Developer Thomas Hanning shipped Run History, an iPhone app that pulls years of runs from Garmin, Coros and Apple Health into one place, kept on your device.
It compares each week, month and year with last year, and estimates VO2max, fitness, fatigue and form, race predictions, and best efforts from 400 meters to the marathon.
It's built with SwiftUI and Swift 6, his own FIT decoder and GRDB. Most of the code was written with Claude Code in the cloud.
